description: This file contains unit tests for the WebSocket transport component of the Pipecat project, testing websocket handling, frame processing, and serializer integration using asyncio and unittest.

classes.name: TestWebSocketTransportService
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass testing WebSocket transport functionalities such as websocket connection handling, frame processing, and serializer usage.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup with a WebSocket transport instance, pipeline, and sample frames.

methods.name: queue_frame
methods.description: Asynchronous helper to enqueue frames into the pipeline with a delay.

methods.name: test_websocket_handler
methods.description: Tests the websocket handler's ability to send serialized frames over the websocket.

methods.name: test_on_connection_decorator
methods.description: Verifies the on_connection decorator registers the connection handler correctly.

methods.name: test_frame_processor
methods.description: Tests the WebSocketFrameProcessor's frame processing logic with various frame types.

methods.name: test_serializer_parameter
methods.description: Checks that custom serializers are used correctly by the transport.
